answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it explicitly reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm, both directly relevant to sustainable long-term revenue. Memory 44 is also strong because higher-quality pipeline is a meaningful leading indicator for durable revenue, though it omits closed-won revenue, retention, and unit economics. Memories 31 and 86 show durable or early-adoption improvements but provide no direct revenue, qualification, retention, or monetization evidence. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift in the relevant price-sensitive SMB segment, but omits durability, margin, retention, discount dependency, and customer quality. Memory 91 only establishes improved early engagement and first meaningful action, without evidence of revenue conversion, qualification, retention, or durability.
